subject: Renewal express lane: slab aggregation + procurement intake
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@avahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal express lane: slab aggregation + procurement intake

Hi Evan —

Congrats again on the product rollout earlier this year. As Ava approaches the annual renewal window, we wanted to propose an "express lane" for procurement to reduce back-and-forth and simplify PO management for the upcoming term change and planned capacity uplift. High level:

- Slab aggregation: consolidate invoices into 3 PO slabs (Baseline, Ramp, Burst) instead of monthly micro-POs.
- Evidence bundle: we’ll provide a single evidence packet (SOC2, KMS attestation, data retention summary) so your team can validate once.
- Term smoothing: offer a 6→12 month blended term option for the first uplift to smooth budget cycles.
- Portal intake: we can pre-fill your procurement portal intake form and submit on your behalf with a signed SOW addendum link.

Attached is a short one-pager that explains the flow and the typical PO banding we recommend. If this sounds useful, suggested next steps:
1) Confirm procurement contact and preferred PO bands (USD ranges for the three slabs)
2) We’ll upload the evidence bundle to your intake link and provide a DocuSign SOW addendum for signatures
3) Once PO is issued, we’ll set up a phased capacity rollout (canary -> ramp -> full) with billing aligned to slab thresholds

Can you confirm whether the procurement portal is the source of truth for PO intake (or should we email a consolidated bundle to procurement@avahealth.com)? Happy to jump on a 20-min sync this week.

Thanks —

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@avahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal express lane: slab aggregation + procurement intake

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the proactive offer. Procurement@avahealth.com is the right inbox; we prefer portal intake but can accept a consolidated email when needed. A few items the team will need before we can progress:

- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and evidence index that maps controls to redwood artifacts
- KMS / key management attestation (who manages keys, HSM or cloud KMS?)
- Data retention policy and deletion SLA for customer data
- Typical invoice cadence and tax/PO language (we need to confirm our AP can consume three slab POs)

Also: who will sign the SOW addendum? We need the counterparty legal name and EIN for the DocuSign envelope. If you can pre-fill the portal intake form and attach the evidence bundle, we’ll route to our legal and finance queues.

Proposed: send the evidence bundle + pre-filled intake by EOD tomorrow and we’ll aim for a 2-week turnaround on our side.

Thanks —
Evan

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the quick reply. Per Karthik’s note we’ve consolidated the evidence and pre-filled the Ava procurement intake form. Links and items below:

- Evidence bundle (single zip): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_express_onboard_AVA — contains SOC2 Type II (2027), KMS attestation, data retention matrix, and encryption whitepaper.
- Suggested PO slab bands (for PO template): Baseline = $40k/mo equivalency; Ramp = $80k/mo equivalency (first 3 months); Burst = $150k/mo equivalency (overage).
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices against slab usage, with automatic reconciliation at slab thresholds.
- Counterparty legal name / EIN: Redwood Inference, Inc. / EIN: 12-3456789
- Signature path: we can deliver via DocuSign or upload to your portal; DocuSign link provided for convenience: https://app.docusign.com/s/start/8f9a-ava-sow-addendum

Attachments: consolidated evidence index + SOW addendum draft. Legal has prepped a short addendum that only covers the ramp schedule and billing cadence — redlines welcome but we ask finance/legal to keep changes focused to avoid delay.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ava confirms portal vs DocuSign (if portal, confirm the intake ticket id once submitted)
2) Procurement confirms PO band ranges and AP can process slab POs (do you want separate POs per slab or a single PO with invoice sub-lines?)
3) Once PO is in place we’ll execute the phased rollout (canary 2 weeks -> ramp 4–6 weeks -> full) and send a kickoff note to the ops team.

If this looks good I can schedule a 20-min alignment call with procurement/legal tomorrow morning.

Best —
